7.3.95: After **तु**, **रु**, **स्तु**, **शम्**, and **अम्**, a **सार्वधातुक** affix beginning with a consonant optionally takes the **ईट्** augment.
7.3.96: After **अस्** and the **सिच्**, a single-consonant **सार्वधातुक** affix takes the **ईट्** augment.
7.3.97: In the **छन्दस्**, a single-consonant **सार्वधातुक** affix variously takes the augment after **अस्** and the **सिच्**।
7.3.98: After **रुद्** and the four roots following it, a single-consonant **सार्वधातुक** affix takes the **ईट्** augment.
7.3.99: In the view of गार्ग्य and गालव, after those five roots (**रुद्** etc.) a single-consonant **सार्वधातुक** affix takes the **अट्** augment instead.
7.3.100: By all grammarians, after **अद्** a single-consonant **सार्वधातुक** affix takes the **अट्** augment.
7.3.101: Before a **सार्वधातुक** affix beginning with a **यञ्** consonant, the final अ of an **अङ्ग** lengthens to आ।
7.3.102: Before a **सुप्** ending beginning with a **यञ्** consonant, the final अ of the **अङ्ग** lengthens to आ।
7.3.103: Before a plural **सुप्** ending beginning with a **झल्** consonant, ए replaces the final अ of the **अङ्ग**।
7.3.104: Before the **सुप्** ending **ओस्**, ए replaces the final अ of the **अङ्ग**।
7.3.105: Before the ओस् of the 6th/7th dual and before the आ (टा) of the 3rd singular, the final आ of a feminine **आप्** affix becomes ए.
7.3.106: In the **सम्बुद्धि** (vocative singular) too, the final आ of a feminine **आप्** affix becomes ए.
7.3.107: In the **सम्बुद्धि**, a stem meaning 'mother' and a **नदी** stem shorten their final vowel.
7.3.108: In the **सम्बुद्धि**, a stem-final short इ or उ takes **गुण** (इ→ए, उ→ओ).
7.3.109: Before **जस्** (अस्, the 1st plural), a stem-final short vowel takes **गुण**.
7.3.110: Before ङि (7th singular) and the **सर्वनामस्थान** cases, a stem-final ऋ takes **गुण** (ऋ→अर्).
7.3.111: Before a ङित् affix, the इ or उ of a **घि** stem takes **गुण**.
7.3.112: After a **नदी** stem, the ङित् case-endings (4th, 5th, 6th singular) take the augment **आट्**.
7.3.113: After a feminine stem ending in **आप्**, the ङित् case-endings (4th, 5th, 6th singular) take the augment **याट्**.
7.3.114: After a pronominal stem ending in feminine आ, the ङित् case-endings (4th, 5th, 6th singular) take the augment **स्याट्**, and the stem's आ shortens to अ.
7.3.115: After द्वितीया and तृतीया, the ङित् case-endings (4th, 5th, 6th singular) optionally take **स्याट्**, with the stem's आ shortening to अ.
7.3.116: After a **नदी** stem, a feminine **आप्** stem, and नी, the इ of ङि (7th singular) becomes **आम्**.
7.3.117: After a **नदी** stem ending in short इ or उ, the इ of ङि (7th singular) becomes **आम्**.
7.3.118: After a stem ending in short इ or उ that is neither **नदी** nor **घि**, the इ of ङि (7th singular) becomes औ.
7.3.119: After a **घि** stem ending in short इ or उ, the इ of ङि (7th singular) becomes औ, and the stem's final इ/उ becomes अ.
7.3.120: After a non-feminine **घि** stem, the आ (टा) of the 3rd singular becomes **ना**.
7.4.1: Before **चङ्** (the reduplicating aorist sign), the penultimate vowel of the causative **अङ्ग** shortens.
7.4.2: This shortening before **चङ्** does not apply to a denominative **अङ्ग** that dropped an **अक्** vowel before णि, nor to शास्, nor to a root with an indicatory ऋ (**ऋदित्**).
7.4.3: For भ्राज्, भास्, भाष्, दीप्, जीव्, मील्, पीड्, the shortening before **चङ्** is optional.
7.4.4: For the causative of पा 'drink' before **चङ्**, the penultimate vowel drops (**लोप**), and the reduplicate's vowel becomes ई.
7.4.5: For the causative of स्था before **चङ्**, the penultimate vowel becomes short इ.
7.4.6: For the causative of घ्रा before **चङ्**, the penultimate vowel optionally becomes short इ.
7.4.7: Before **चङ्**, a penultimate ऋ or ॠ of the causative **अङ्ग** optionally becomes short ऋ (blocking the इर्, अर्, आर् substitutes).
7.4.8: In the **छन्दस्**, a penultimate ऋ or ॠ of the causative **अङ्ग** before **चङ्** always becomes short ऋ.
7.4.9: Before **लिट्** (the perfect), दय् (दे, root देङ् 'protect') becomes दिगि (blocking reduplication).
7.4.10: A root ending in short ऋ and beginning with a conjunct consonant takes **गुण** in **लिट्** (the perfect).
7.4.11: ऋच्छ्, ऋ, and roots ending in long ॠ take **गुण** in **लिट्** (the perfect).
7.4.12: शॄ, दॄ, पॄ (of the क्र्यादि class) optionally shorten their vowel in **लिट्** (the perfect).
7.4.13: Before the affix क, a preceding **अण्** vowel (आ, ई, ऊ) shortens.
7.4.14: Before the **समासान्त** affix **कप्** (after a **बहुव्रीहि**), an **अण्** vowel does not shorten.
7.4.15: Before the **प्रत्यय** कप्, a feminine **अङ्ग** ending in आ optionally keeps its आ instead of shortening it.
7.4.16: A root ending in ऋ or ॠ, and दृश्, takes **गुण** in its vowel before the Aorist अङ्.
7.4.17: अस् takes the augment थुक् before the Aorist अङ्.
7.4.18: श्वि changes its final to अ before the Aorist अङ्.
7.4.19: पत् takes the augment प् after its vowel before the Aorist अङ्.
7.4.20: वच् takes the augment उ after its अ before the Aorist अङ्.
7.4.21: शीङ् takes **गुण** in its vowel before a **सार्वधातुक** affix.
7.4.22: शीङ् changes its ई to अय् before a **कित्** or **ङित्** affix beginning with य्.
7.4.23: After an **उपसर्ग**, ऊह् shortens its ऊ before a **कित्** or **ङित्** affix beginning with य्.
7.4.24: After an **उपसर्ग**, इ shortens its vowel before the Benedictive augment यास्.
7.4.25: Before a **कित्** or **ङित्** affix beginning with य् that is neither **कृत्** nor **सार्वधातुक**, an **अङ्ग** lengthens its final vowel.
7.4.26: Before the **च्वि** affix, an **अङ्ग** lengthens its final vowel.
7.4.27: An **अङ्ग** ending in short ऋ changes that ऋ to री before a non-**कृत्**, non-**सार्वधातुक** affix beginning with य्, and before **च्वि**.
7.4.28: A root ending in short ऋ changes that ऋ to रि before श, before the Passive य् (यक्), and before the Benedictive यास्.
7.4.29: ऋ (अर्ति), and roots ending in ऋ where a conjunct consonant precedes it, take **गुण** before the Passive यक् and the Benedictive यास्.
7.4.30: ऋ (अर्ति), and roots ending in ऋ where a conjunct consonant precedes it, take **गुण** before the Intensive यङ्.
7.4.31: घ्रा and ध्मा change their vowel to long ई before the Intensive यङ्.
7.4.32: A nominal **अङ्ग** ending in अ or आ changes that final to long ई before the **च्वि** affix.
7.4.33: A nominal **अङ्ग** ending in अ or आ changes that final to long ई before the Denominative क्यच्.
7.4.34: अशनाय (hungry), उदन्य (thirsty), and धनाय (greedy) are the irregular Denominative roots in those three senses.
7.4.35: In the **छन्दस्**, the lengthening and the change to long ई of an **अङ्ग**'s final vowel before क्यच् do not apply, except for पुत्र.
7.4.36: दुरस्यु, द्रविणस्यु, वृषण्यति, and रिषण्यति are the irregular Denominative forms in the **छन्दस्**.
7.4.37: In the **छन्दस्**, अश्व and अघ change their final to long आ before the Denominative क्यच्.
7.4.38: देव and सुम्न change their final to long आ before the Denominative क्यच् in the यजुस् of the काठक.
7.4.39: In the ऋच्, कवि, अध्वर, and पृतना drop their final before the Denominative क्यच्.
7.4.40: दो, सो, मा, and स्था change their final to short इ before a **कित्** affix beginning with त्.
7.4.41: शा and छा optionally change their final to short इ before a **कित्** affix beginning with त्.
7.4.42: धा (दधाति) changes to हि before a **कित्** affix beginning with त्.
7.4.43: हा (जहाति) optionally changes to हि before क्त्वा.
7.4.44: In the **छन्दस्**, हा (जहाति) optionally changes to हि before क्त्वा.
7.4.45: सुधित, वसुधित, नेमधित, धिष्व, धिषीय are the irregular Vedic forms of धा (with क्त, and in the imperative and benedictive).
7.4.46: दा as a **घु** (दा, धा reckoned घु) becomes दद् before a **कित्** **प्रत्यय** beginning with त्.
7.4.47: After an **उपसर्ग** ending in a vowel, the vowel of **घु** दा becomes त् before a **कित्** **प्रत्यय** beginning with त्.
7.4.48: The final of the **अङ्ग** अप् becomes त् before a **विभक्ति** beginning with भ्.
7.4.49: A root's final स् becomes त् before an **आर्धधातुक** **प्रत्यय** beginning with स्.
7.4.50: The final स् of तास् and of अस् drops before a **प्रत्यय** beginning with स्.
7.4.51: The final स् of तास् and of अस् drops before a **प्रत्यय** beginning with र्.
7.4.52: The final स् of तास् and of अस् becomes ह् before the ending ए.
7.4.53: The final of दीधी and वेवी drops before a **प्रत्यय** beginning with य्, इ, or ई.
7.4.54: Before the **सन्** beginning with स् (the **अनिट्** **सन्**), the root-vowel of मी, मा, घु (धा), रभ्, लभ्, शक्, पत्, पद्, दा becomes इस्.
7.4.55: Before the **सन्** beginning with स्, the vowel of आप्, ज्ञपि, ऋध् becomes long ई.
7.4.56: Before the **सन्** beginning with स्, the vowel of दम्भ् becomes इ as well as ई.
7.4.57: Before the **अनिट्** **सन्**, intransitive मुच् optionally takes **गुण** in its vowel.
7.4.58: In the cases of 7.4.54 through 7.4.57, the **अभ्यास** (reduplicate) drops; and **अभ्यासस्य** carries forward through the rest of the chapter.
7.4.59: A long vowel of the **अभ्यास** becomes short.
7.4.60: Of the consonants of the **अभ्यास**, only the first stays; the rest drop.
7.4.61: When a sibilant precedes, only the **खय्** consonant (and the sibilant before it) of the **अभ्यास** stays; the rest drop.
7.4.62: A guttural or ह् of the **अभ्यास** becomes the matching palatal.
7.4.63: The guttural of the **अभ्यास** of कु (कवते) does not become a palatal in the **यङ्** (intensive).
7.4.64: In the **छन्दस्**, the guttural of the **अभ्यास** of कृष् does not become a palatal in the **यङ्** (intensive).
7.4.65: दाधर्ति, दर्धर्ति, दर्धर्षि, बोभूतु, तेतिक्ते, अलर्षि, आपनीफणत्, संसनिष्यदत्, करिक्रत्, कनिक्रदत्, भरिभ्रत्, दविध्वतः, दविद्युतत्, तरित्रतः, सरीसृपतम्, वरीवृजत्, मर्मृज्य, आगनीगन्ति are the irregularly reduplicated forms found in the **छन्दस्**.
7.4.66: ऋ or ॠ of the **अभ्यास** becomes अर् (अर्, per उरण् रपरः).
7.4.67: The semivowel of the **अभ्यास** of द्युत् and of स्वापि (causative of स्वप्) undergoes **सम्प्रसारण**.
7.4.68: The semivowel of the **अभ्यास** of व्यथ् undergoes **सम्प्रसारण** in the **लिट्**.
7.4.69: The **अभ्यास** of इ (एति) takes a long vowel before a **कित्** **लिट्** ending.
7.4.70: In the **लिट्**, the initial अ of the **अभ्यास** becomes long आ.
7.4.71: After that lengthened आ of the **अभ्यास**, the augment **नुट्** (न्) is added to the root's short अ when the root ends in two consonants.
7.4.72: After the lengthened आ of the **अभ्यास** of अश् (अश्नोति), the augment **नुट्** (न्) comes in the **लिट्**.
7.4.73: The vowel of the **अभ्यास** of भू becomes अ in the **लिट्**.
7.4.74: ससूव (from सू) is the irregular **लिट्** form in the **छन्दस्**.
7.4.75: In the reduplicated present (**श्लु**) of निज्, विज्, विष्, the **अभ्यास** vowel takes **गुण**.
7.4.76: In the reduplicated present (**श्लु**) of भृ, मा (माङ्), and हा (ओहाङ्), इ replaces the **अभ्यास** vowel.
7.4.77: In the reduplicated present (**श्लु**) of ऋ and पृ, इ replaces the **अभ्यास** vowel.
7.4.78: In the **छन्दस्**, इ variously replaces the **अभ्यास** vowel in the reduplicated present (**श्लु**).
7.4.79: In the **सन्** (desiderative), इ replaces a final short अ of the **अभ्यास**.
7.4.80: In the **सन्**, इ replaces a final उ or ऊ of the **अभ्यास** before a labial, a **यण्**, or ज् that is itself followed by अ or आ.
7.4.81: In the **सन्**, for स्रु, श्रु, द्रु, प्रु, प्लु, च्यु, इ optionally replaces the final उ of the **अभ्यास** when the **यण्** is followed by अ or आ.
7.4.82: Before the intensive **यङ्**, and when **यङ्** is dropped, the final **इक्** (इ, उ with their longs) of the **अभ्यास** takes **गुण**.
7.4.83: In the intensive (**यङ्** present or dropped), the अ of the **अभ्यास** lengthens when the **अभ्यास** takes no क्-marked augment.
7.4.84: In the intensive (**यङ्** present or dropped), the **अभ्यास** of वञ्च्, स्रंस्, ध्वंस्, भ्रंश्, कस्, पत्, पद्, स्कन्द् takes the augment नीक्.
7.4.85: In the intensive (**यङ्** present or dropped), the augment नुक् (न्) follows the short अ of the **अभ्यास** when the **अङ्ग** ends in a nasal.
7.4.86: In the intensive (**यङ्** present or dropped), the **अभ्यास** of जप्, जभ्, दह्, दश् (दंश्), भञ्ज्, पश् takes the augment नुक् (न्).
7.4.87: In the intensive (**यङ्** present or dropped), the **अभ्यास** of चर् and फल् takes the augment नुक् (न्).
7.4.88: In the intensive (**यङ्** present or dropped) of चर् and फल्, उ replaces the अ that follows the **अभ्यास** (the root's अ, not the **अभ्यास**'s).
7.4.89: उ replaces the vowel of चर् and फल् before a **प्रत्यय** beginning with त्.
7.4.90: In the intensive (**यङ्** present or dropped), the **अभ्यास** of a root with penultimate ऋ takes the augment रीक्.
7.4.91: When the intensive **यङ्** is dropped, the **अभ्यास** of a root with penultimate ऋ takes the augment रुक् (र्) or रिक् (रि), and by च also रीक् (री).
7.4.92: When the intensive **यङ्** is dropped, the **अभ्यास** of a root ending in short ऋ takes the augment रिक् (रि), रुक् (र्), or रीक् (री).
7.4.93: In the reduplicated **चङ्** aorist of the causative, the **अभ्यास** before a light root-vowel is treated as in the **सन्**, provided no **अक्** vowel of the root was dropped before the causative णि.
7.4.94: In the reduplicated **चङ्** aorist of the causative, a prosodially short **अभ्यास** vowel lengthens when the root-vowel after it is light and no **अक्** was dropped before णि.
7.4.95: In the reduplicated **चङ्** aorist of the causative of स्मृ, दॄ, त्वर्, प्रथ्, म्रद्, स्तॄ, स्पश्, short अ replaces the **अभ्यास** vowel.
7.4.96: In the reduplicated **चङ्** aorist of the causative of वेष्ट् and चेष्ट्, short अ optionally replaces the **अभ्यास** vowel.
7.4.97: In the reduplicated **चङ्** aorist of the causative of गण्, ई optionally replaces the **अभ्यास** vowel, and by च also अ.
8.1.1: Through 8.1.15, supply "the whole word is doubled" in each rule that follows.
8.1.2: Of a doubled form, the latter member is the **आम्रेडित**.
8.1.4: The whole word is doubled in the senses of "always" (continuous repetition) and "each" (**वीप्सा**, distribution over every instance).
8.1.5: परि is doubled when it means "excluding."
8.1.6: In the **छन्दस्**, प्र, सम्, उ, उत् are doubled when the doubling completes a quarter of the verse.
8.1.7: उपरि, अधि, अधस् are doubled when they express unbroken nearness (in space or time).
8.1.8: A **आमन्त्रित** (vocative) at the start of a sentence doubles when the speaker means envy, praise, anger, blame, or threat.
8.1.9: When एक doubles, the pair counts as a **बहुव्रीहि** (so the first member's case affix drops and it goes masculine).
8.1.10: A word doubles and the pair counts as a **बहुव्रीहि** when distress over something is meant.
8.1.11: In the rules that follow, the doubled word counts as a **कर्मधारय**.
8.1.12: A **गुणवचन** (attribute word) doubles when it means the thing only somewhat resembles, not fully has, that quality; the pair counts as a **कर्मधारय**.
8.1.13: प्रिय and सुख optionally double when they mean 'with ease, untroubled'.
8.1.14: यथायथम् is the irregular form, doubled and neuter, meaning 'each according to its own'.
8.1.15: द्वन्द्वम् is the irregular form meaning 'secret', and also marks a limit, a separation, use of sacrificial vessels, or manifestation.
8.1.16: From here through इडाया वा [[8.3.54]], supply **पदस्य** — every following rule acts on a whole **पद**.
8.1.17: From here through सगतिरपि तिङ् [[8.1.68]], supply **पदात्** — every following rule acts on what stands after a **पद**.
8.1.18: From here through [[8.1.74]], supply अनुदात्तं सर्वम् अपादादौ — the whole thing goes **अनुदात्त** unless it begins a verse-foot.
8.1.19: An **आमन्त्रित** (vocative) goes wholly **अनुदात्त** after a preceding **पद**, unless it begins a verse-foot.
8.1.20: In the genitive, dative, and accusative dual, युष्मद् becomes वाम् and अस्मद् becomes नौ (after a **पद**, **अनुदात्त**).
8.1.21: In the genitive, dative, and accusative plural, युष्मद् becomes वस् and अस्मद् becomes नस् (after a **पद**, **अनुदात्त**).
8.1.22: In the genitive and dative singular, युष्मद् becomes ते and अस्मद् becomes मे (after a **पद**, **अनुदात्त**).
8.1.23: In the accusative singular, युष्मद् becomes त्वा and अस्मद् becomes मा (after a **पद**, **अनुदात्त**).
8.1.24: These substitutes are blocked when च, वा, ह, अह, or एव is tied to the pronoun.
8.1.25: These substitutes are also blocked with verbs of 'seeing' when they mean knowing, not physical sight.
8.1.26: When the pronoun follows a nominative that itself has a word before it, these substitutes are optional.
8.1.27: गोत्र and the rest go **अनुदात्त** after a **तिङ्** (finite verb) when contempt or repetition is meant.
8.1.28: A **तिङ्** (finite verb) goes **अनुदात्त** after a preceding word that is not a **तिङ्**.
8.1.30: A **तिङ्** keeps its accent when tied to यत्, यदि, हन्त, कुवित्, नेत्, चेत्, चण्, कच्चित्, or यत्र.
8.1.31: A **तिङ्** keeps its accent when tied to नह used to throw a rejection back as a taunt.
8.1.32: A **तिङ्** keeps its accent when tied to सत्य in a question.
8.1.33: A **तिङ्** keeps its accent when tied to अङ्ग in friendly assertion.
8.1.34: A **तिङ्** keeps its accent when tied to हि in friendly assertion.
8.1.35: In the **छन्दस्**, a **तिङ्** tied to हि and correlated to another verb keeps its accent — sometimes one verb, sometimes more than one.
8.1.36: A **तिङ्** keeps its accent when tied to यावत् or यथा.
8.1.37: But not when यावत् or यथा immediately precede the verb and mean praise — there it goes **अनुदात्त**.
8.1.38: A finite verb still loses its accent after यावत् or यथा meaning praise even when an **उपसर्ग** stands between them — the प्रefix does not break the immediacy.
8.1.39: A finite verb after तु, पश्य, पश्यत, or अह meaning praise keeps its accent.
8.1.40: A finite verb after अहो meaning praise keeps its accent.
8.1.41: A finite verb after अहो in any other sense optionally keeps its accent.
8.1.42: A finite verb after पुरा meaning haste (पुरा pointing to something about to happen) optionally keeps its accent.
8.1.43: A finite verb after ननु used to ask permission keeps its accent.
8.1.44: A finite verb after किम् asking about an action keeps its accent, provided the verb has no **उपसर्ग** and no negation.
8.1.45: When किम् is dropped but the question about an action remains, the finite verb (with no **उपसर्ग**, no negation) optionally keeps its accent.
8.1.46: After एहि मन्ये used in mockery, the following **लृट्** (future) keeps its accent.
8.1.47: A finite verb after जातु keeps its accent, when no word precedes जातु.
8.1.48: A finite verb keeps its accent after any form of किम् followed by चित्, when no word precedes that किम्-form.
8.1.49: A finite verb keeps its accent right after आहो or उताहो, when no word precedes them.
8.1.50: When आहो or उताहो do not stand right before the verb, the finite verb optionally keeps its accent.
8.1.51: A **लृट्** (future) keeps its accent after the **लोट्** (imperative) of a verb of motion, provided the subject and object of the two verbs are not entirely different.
8.1.52: A **लोट्** (imperative) also keeps its accent after the **लोट्** of a verb of motion, provided the subject and object of the two are not entirely different.
8.1.53: A **लोट्** carrying an **उपसर्ग** and not in the first person optionally keeps its accent after the **लोट्** of a verb of motion, provided the कारक is not entirely different.
8.1.54: A **लोट्** carrying an **उपसर्ग** and not in the first person optionally keeps its accent after हन्त.
8.1.55: After आम्, with at most one word between, an **आमन्त्रित** (vocative) keeps its accent when the one addressed is not nearby.
8.1.56: In the **छन्दस्**, a finite verb followed by यत्, हि, or तु keeps its accent.
8.1.57: A finite verb not preceded by a **गति** keeps its accent before चन, चित्, इव, a **गोत्रादि** word, a **तद्धित** affix, or its own doubled form (**आम्रेडित**).
8.1.58: A finite verb not preceded by a **गति** keeps its accent before the चादि particles च, वा, ह, अह, एव.
8.1.59: When च or वा joins two finite verbs, only the first keeps its accent.
8.1.60: With ह, the first finite verb keeps its accent when a breach of proper conduct is being reproached.
8.1.61: With अह, the first finite verb keeps its accent when several separate commissions are assigned (and also, as with ह, when a breach of conduct is reproached).
8.1.62: When च or अह is dropped and एव takes their place with limiting force, the first finite verb still keeps its accent.
8.1.63: When the चादि particles च, वा, ह, अह, एव are dropped, the first finite verb optionally keeps its accent.
8.1.64: In the **छन्दस्**, with वै or वाव, the first finite verb optionally keeps its accent.
8.1.65: In the **छन्दस्**, with एक and अन्य used in the same sense ('the one... the other'), the first finite verb optionally keeps its accent.
8.1.66: After यद् in any of its forms, the finite verb always keeps its accent.
8.1.67: After a praising word of the काष्ठादि class, the following member naming what is praised becomes **अनुदात्त**.
8.1.68: After a word of praise (काष्ठं and the like), the finite verb being praised becomes **अनुदात्त**, together with its preceding **गति** (an उपसर्ग) if it has one.
8.1.69: A finite verb, together with its preceding **गति** if it has one, becomes **अनुदात्त** before a following noun that faults the action (but not before गोत्र and the like).
8.1.71: A **गति** becomes **अनुदात्त** before an accented finite verb.
8.1.72: A preceding **आमन्त्रित** (vocative) counts as not there — operations its presence would trigger don't apply, and operations that need it absent do (it doesn't deaccent the following word, and the short forms of युष्मद्/अस्मद् don't appear).
8.1.73: A preceding **आमन्त्रित** that is a generic word does not count as absent when a second **आमन्त्रित** in apposition follows; it stays present, and that second vocative loses its accent.
8.1.74: When the preceding **आमन्त्रित** is plural and the following **आमन्त्रित** in apposition is a specific word, the preceding one optionally counts as absent.
8.2.1: From here to the end of the book, treat each rule as if the ones after it are unaware of it (so a later rule's result is **असिद्ध** — invisible — to an earlier rule, and within these chapters too each later rule is invisible to each earlier one).
8.2.2: The dropping of a final **न्** by [[8.2.7]] is **असिद्ध** — invisible — for rules about case-endings, about accent, about any **संज्ञा**, and about the augment **तुक्** before a **कृत्** affix.
8.2.3: But the **मु** substitution of [[8.2.80]] is not **असिद्ध** before the ending **ना**; there it counts as done.
8.2.4: An **अनुदात्त** vowel becomes **स्वरित** after a **यण्** that itself replaced an **उदात्त** or **स्वरित** vowel.
8.2.5: The single replacement of an **अनुदात्त** vowel together with an **उदात्त** vowel is **उदात्त**.
8.2.6: The single replacement of an **उदात्त** vowel together with an **अनुदात्त** vowel that begins a word is optionally **स्वरित** or **उदात्त**.
8.2.7: The final **न्** of a **प्रातिपदिक** that is a **पद** drops.
8.2.8: That **न्** does not drop before the locative singular ending **ङि** or in the vocative singular (**सम्बुद्धि**).
8.2.9: The **म्** of **मतुप्** becomes **व्** after an **अङ्ग** that ends in or has as its penult **म्**, **अ**, or **आ** — but not after यव and the like.
8.2.10: The **म्** of **मतुप्** becomes **व्** after an **अङ्ग** ending in a **झय्** consonant (a stop).
8.2.11: The **म्** of **मतुप्** becomes **व्** when the resulting word is a **संज्ञा** (a name).
8.2.12: आसन्दीवत्, अष्ठीवत्, चक्रीवत्, कक्षीवत्, रुमण्वत्, and चर्मण्वती are the irregularly built names (with **व्** for the **म्** of **मतुप्** over altered stems).
8.2.13: उदन्वान् is the irregular form (उदक taking **मतुप्** with उदन्) when it means the sea.
8.2.14: राजन्वान् is the form (राजन् + **मतुप्** without dropping the **न्**) when it means good rule.
8.2.15: In the **छन्दस्**, the **म्** of **मतुप्** becomes **व्** after an **अङ्ग** ending in **इ/ई** or **र्**.
8.2.16: In the **छन्दस्**, **मतुप्** takes the augment **नुट्** after an **अङ्ग** ending in **अन्**.
8.2.17: In the **छन्दस्**, **तरप्** and **तमप्** (the **घ** affixes) take the augment **नुट्** after a stem ending in **न्**.
8.2.18: The **र्** of the root कृप् becomes **ल्**.
8.2.19: The **र्** of an उपसर्ग becomes **ल्** before अयते.
8.2.20: The **र्** of गॄ becomes **ल्** before **यङ्** (the intensive).
8.2.21: **र्** optionally becomes **ल्** before an affix beginning with a vowel.
8.2.22: The **र्** of परि optionally becomes **ल्** before घ and अङ्क.
8.2.23: A **पद** ending in a consonant cluster drops its last consonant.
8.2.24: In a word ending in a conjunct consonant, only स् drops after र् (no other consonant after र् drops). This is a **नियम** rule: even though स् would drop after र् anyway by the next rule, restating it confines the dropping to स् alone.
8.2.25: स् drops before a **प्रत्यय** beginning with ध.
8.2.26: स् drops after a **झल्** consonant when a **प्रत्यय** beginning with a **झल्** consonant follows.
8.2.27: स् drops after an **अङ्ग** ending in a short vowel when a **प्रत्यय** beginning with a **झल्** consonant follows.
8.2.28: स् drops after the augment **इट्** when the augment **ईट्** follows it.
8.2.29: स् or क्, first in a conjunct consonant, drops before a **झल्** **प्रत्यय** and at the end of a word.
8.2.30: A palatal becomes the matching guttural before a **झल्** consonant and at the end of a word.
8.2.31: ह becomes ढ before a **झल्** consonant and at the end of a word.
8.2.32: In a root beginning with द, ह becomes घ before a **झल्** consonant and at the end of a word.
8.2.33: The ह of द्रुह्, मुह्, ष्णुह्, ष्णिह् optionally becomes घ before a **झल्** consonant and at the end of a word.
8.2.34: The ह of नह् becomes ध before a **झल्** consonant and at the end of a word.
8.2.35: The ह of आह् becomes थ before a **झल्** consonant.
8.2.36: The final consonant of व्रश्च्, भ्रस्ज्, सृज्, मृज्, यज्, राज्, भ्राज्, and final छ and श, becomes ष् before a **झल्** consonant and at the end of a word.
8.2.37: In a one-syllable root ending in **झष्** (झ, भ, घ, ढ, ध), an initial ब, ग, ड, द becomes the matching भ, घ, ढ, ध before स्, before ध्व, and at the end of a word.
8.2.38: In दध (the reduplicated धा), the initial द becomes ध before त, थ, स, and before ध्व.
8.2.39: A **झल्** consonant becomes its matching **जश्** (ज, ब, ग, ड, द) at the end of a word.
8.2.40: त or थ becomes ध after **झष्** (झ, भ, घ, ढ, ध), except after the root धा (दध).
8.2.41: ष or ढ becomes क before स.
8.2.42: After र and द, the त of the **निष्ठा** **प्रत्यय** त or तवत् becomes न, and a preceding द becomes न too.
8.2.43: The **निष्ठा** त becomes न after a root that ends in आ and begins with a conjunct consonant containing a **यण्** (semivowel).
8.2.44: The **निष्ठा** त becomes न after लू and the roots that follow it.
8.2.45: The **निष्ठा** त becomes न after a root with an indicatory ओ in the **धातुपाठ**.
8.2.46: The **निष्ठा** त becomes न after क्षि when its vowel is lengthened.
8.2.47: The **निष्ठा** त becomes न after श्यै, but not when the participle means 'cold'.
8.2.48: The **निष्ठा** त becomes न after अञ्च्, but not when an ablative (अपादान) is in construction.
8.2.49: The **निष्ठा** त becomes न after दिव् when the sense is not gambling.
8.2.50: निर्वाण is formed by changing the **निष्ठा** त of निर् + वा to न when the sense is not wind.
8.2.51: The **निष्ठा** त becomes क after शुष्.
8.2.52: The **निष्ठा** त becomes व after पच्.
8.2.53: The **निष्ठा** त becomes म after क्षै.
8.2.54: After **स्त्यै** preceded by प्र, the **निष्ठा** त optionally becomes म (so प्रस्तीमः or प्रस्तीतः).
8.2.55: फुल्ल, क्षीब, कृश, उल्लाघ are the irregular **निष्ठा** forms only when no **उपसर्ग** precedes.
8.2.56: After नुद, विद, उन्द, त्रा, घ्रा, ह्री the **निष्ठा** त optionally becomes न।
8.2.57: After ध्या, ख्या, पॄ, मूर्छि, मद the **निष्ठा** त does not become न।
8.2.58: वित्त (with त kept, not turned to न) means 'wealth' or 'renowned'.
8.2.60: ऋण (with त turned to न) is the form meaning 'debt'.
8.2.61: In the **छन्दस्**, नसत्त, निषत्त, अनुत्त, प्रतूर्त, सूर्त, गूर्त are the irregular **निष्ठा** forms.
8.2.62: A stem built with **क्विन्** changes its final consonant to a guttural at the end of a word.
8.2.63: A final नश् at the end of a word optionally changes to a guttural.
8.2.64: A root's final म becomes न at the end of a word.
8.2.65: A root's final म becomes न before an affix beginning with म or व।
8.2.66: A final स् of a word, and the ष् of सजुष्, become रु at the end of a word.
8.2.67: The **निष्ठा**-final of अवयाः, श्वेतवाः, पुरोडाः also becomes रु।
8.2.68: The न् of अहन् becomes रु at the end of a word.
8.2.69: The न् of अहन् becomes र् when no **सुप्** follows.
8.2.70: In the **छन्दस्**, the final of अमनस्, ऊधस्, अवस् becomes either रु or र्।
8.2.71: In the **छन्दस्**, the final of भुवस् as a **महाव्याहृति** becomes either रु or र्।
8.2.72: The स् of a word ending in **वस्**, and the final of स्रंस्, ध्वंस्, अनडुह्, become द at the end of a word.
8.2.73: A root's final स् (except अस्) becomes द before the ending ति when it stands at the end of a word.
8.2.74: A root's final स् before the ending सि, standing at the end of a word, optionally becomes रु or द्।
8.2.75: A root's final द् before the ending सि, standing at the end of a word, optionally becomes रु or द्।
8.2.76: When a root's final र् or व् stands at the end of a word, a penultimate **इक्** vowel (इ, उ) lengthens.
8.2.77: Before a consonant-initial affix, a root's penultimate इ or उ lengthens when the root ends in र् or व्।
8.2.78: Before a consonant, a root's penultimate इ or उ lengthens when र् or व् is its second-to-last letter.
8.2.79: This lengthening does not happen in a **भ** stem ending in र् or व्, nor in कुर् and छुर्।
8.2.80: When **अदस्** does not end in स्, the vowel after द् becomes उ (or ऊ), and द् becomes म्।
8.2.81: The ए after the द् of अदस् becomes ई, and द् becomes म्, when plurality is meant.
8.2.82: From here on: the last vowel (**टि**) of a sentence is **प्लुत** and takes the **उदात्त**।
8.2.83: In answer to a salutation, but not when it addresses a **शूद्र**, the sentence's last vowel becomes **प्लुत** and takes the **उदात्त**।
8.2.84: In calling someone from a distance, the last vowel of the sentence becomes **प्लुत** and **उदात्त**.
8.2.85: When है or हे is used in calling from a distance, the है or हे alone takes the **प्लुत** and the **उदात्त** (even though it is not at the end).
8.2.86: For the Easterners: in calling from a distance, any heavy vowel except ऋ takes the **प्लुत** and **उदात्त** — one vowel at a time — even when it is not the last.
8.2.87: ओम् at the start of a sacred text is **प्लुत**.
8.2.88: ये before यजामहे in a sacrificial recitation is **प्लुत**.
8.2.89: In a sacrificial work the **प्रणव** (ओ३म्) replaces the final syllable — vowel with its following consonant — of the sentence.
8.2.90: In a sacrificial work, the last vowel ending a **याज्या** **मन्त्र** is **प्लुत** and **उदात्त**.
8.2.91: In a sacrificial work, the first syllable of ब्रूहि, प्रेष्य, श्रौषट्, वौषट्, and आवह is **प्लुत**.
8.2.92: In an order to the **अग्नीध्र** priest, the first syllable and the one after it are both **प्लुत**.
8.2.93: हि ending an answer to a question is optionally **प्लुत**.
8.2.94: In throwing back a refuted claim to taunt the loser, the sentence's last syllable is optionally **प्लुत**.
8.2.95: The last syllable of the **आम्रेडित** (the doubled vocative) is **प्लुत** when it threatens.
8.2.96: A finite verb joined with अङ्ग, in a threat, takes **प्लुत** on its last syllable when it calls for a further sentence to finish the sense.
8.2.97: The last syllable of a sentence weighing two alternatives is **प्लुत**.
8.2.98: In ordinary speech only the last vowel of the first alternative is **प्लुत**.
8.2.99: The last syllable of a sentence of assent, promise, or acknowledgment is **प्लुत**.
8.2.100: The vowel ending a question or an expression of praise is **प्लुत** but **अनुदात्त**.
8.2.101: When चित् is actually used to mean comparison, the sentence's last vowel becomes **प्लुत** and **अनुदात्त**.
8.2.102: In उपरि, स्विद्, and आसीद् the last vowel is **प्लुत** and **अनुदात्त**.
8.2.103: Before the **आम्रेडित** (the doubled vocative), the first vocative's last vowel becomes **प्लुत** and **स्वरित** when envy, approval, anger, or blame is meant.
8.2.104: In censuring a breach of conduct, in a benediction, or in a command, a finite verb's last syllable becomes **प्लुत** and **स्वरित** when it calls for a further sentence to finish the sense.
8.2.105: In a question or a narration, the last vowel of a word becomes **प्लुत** and **स्वरित** even when the word is not the last in the sentence.
8.2.106: When ऐ and औ are made **प्लुत**, the **प्लुत** falls on their second element, इ and उ.
8.2.107: For an **एच्** that is not **प्रगृह्य**, when it is made **प्लुत** in any case except calling from a distance, the first half becomes **प्लुत** आ and the second becomes इ or उ.
8.2.108: इ and उ become य् and व् before a vowel in **संहिता**. (And from here on, every rule applies only in **संहिता**, continuous speech.)
8.3.1: In the **छन्दस्**, the final त् or स् of a word ending in मत् or वस् becomes रु in the vocative singular.
8.3.2: From here through [[8.3.12]], supply this: the vowel before the letter replaced by रु optionally becomes nasal.
8.3.3: आ before रु always becomes nasal when an **अट्** letter (a vowel, or ह, य, व, र) follows.
8.3.4: When the vowel before रु is not made nasal, **अनुस्वार** is added after it instead.
8.3.5: The म् of सम् becomes रु before the augment सुट् (and the preceding अ thereby becomes nasal or takes **अनुस्वार**).
8.3.6: The म् of **पुम्** becomes **रु** before a surd stop (**खय्**) that is itself followed by a vowel, semivowel, or nasal (**अम्**).
8.3.7: A word-final न्, except the न् of प्रशान्, becomes **रु** before a **छव्** letter (छ, ठ, थ, च, ट, त) that is itself followed by an **अम्** letter (vowel, semivowel, or nasal).
8.3.8: In the **ऋच्** verses this **रु** substitution is optional: the न् either becomes रु or stays.
8.3.9: A word-final न् after a long vowel optionally becomes **रु** before an **अट्** letter (vowel or semivowel, but not ल्) when both stand in the same **पाद** of an **ऋच्** verse.
8.3.10: The न् of नॄन् optionally becomes **रु** before प्.
8.3.11: The न् of स्वतवान् becomes **रु** before पायु।
8.3.12: The न् of कान् becomes **रु** before a following कान् that is an **आम्रेडित** (the doubled repetition).
8.3.15: A word-final र् becomes **विसर्जनीय** before a **खर्** consonant or at a pause.
8.3.16: **रु** (and only रु, not any other र्) becomes **विसर्जनीय** before the locative plural सुप्।
8.3.17: **रु** (and only रु) preceded by भो, भगो, अघो, अ, or आ becomes य् before an **अश्** letter (vowel or soft consonant).
8.3.18: By शाकटायन, the व् and य् of these forms (the य् after भो, भगो, अघो and the व्/य् after अ or आ) at the end of a **पद** are spoken with lighter articulation before an **अश्** letter (vowel or soft consonant).
8.3.19: By शाकल्य, a word-final व् or य् after अ or आ optionally drops before an **अश्** letter (vowel or soft consonant).
8.3.20: By गार्ग्य, a य् after ओ drops before an **अश्** letter (vowel or soft consonant). This one is invariable.
8.3.21: A word-final व् or य् after अ or आ drops, invariably, before the particle उ (**उञ्**) when उ stands as its own **पद**।
8.3.22: By everyone, this य् (after भो, भगो, अघो, अ, or आ) drops before a consonant (**हल्**).
8.3.23: A word-final म् becomes **अनुस्वार** before a consonant.
8.3.24: A न् or म् that is not word-final becomes **अनुस्वार** before a **झल्** consonant.
8.3.25: The म् of सम् stays म् (rather than turning to अनुस्वार) before राज् ending in **क्विप्**।
8.3.26: Before ह that is itself followed by म्, a word-final म् optionally stays म् (rather than turning to अनुस्वार).
8.3.27: A word-final म् optionally becomes न् before ह that is itself followed by न्.
8.3.28: A word-final ङ् optionally takes the augment क् (**कुक्**), and a word-final ण् the augment ट् (**टुक्**), before a sibilant (**शर्**).
8.3.29: After a word ending in ड्, a word beginning with स् optionally takes the augment ध् (**धुट्**) at its front.
8.3.30: After a word ending in न्, a word beginning with स् optionally takes the augment ध् (**धुट्**) at its front.
8.3.31: A word-final न् optionally takes the augment त् (**तुक्**) before a word beginning with श्.
8.3.32: After a word ending in ङ्, ण्, or न् preceded by a short vowel, the matching consonant (**ङमुट्**: ङ्, ण्, or न्) is added, invariably, at the front of the next word when that word begins with a vowel.
8.3.33: The particle उ (**उञ्**) after a **मय्** consonant (any consonant except the semivowels, sibilants, ह, and ञ) optionally becomes व् before a vowel.
8.3.34: A **विसर्जनीय** becomes स् before a **खर्** consonant that is itself followed by a sibilant (**शर्**).
8.3.35: A **विसर्जनीय** stays **विसर्जनीय** before a **खर्** consonant that is itself followed by a sibilant (**शर्**).
8.3.36: Before a sibilant (**शर्**), a **विसर्ग** optionally stays **विसर्ग** (otherwise it assimilates to the following sibilant).
8.3.37: Before a hard guttural a **विसर्ग** optionally becomes the **जिह्वामूलीय** ᳵ, and before a hard labial the **उपध्मानीय** ᳶ; it may also stay **विसर्ग**.
8.3.38: A **विसर्ग** becomes स् before an affix beginning with a hard guttural or labial (the guttural/labial sits at the start of an affix, not a word) — before पाश, कल्प, क, काम्य.
8.3.39: A **विसर्ग** preceded by इ or उ becomes ष् before an affix beginning with a hard guttural or labial.
8.3.40: The **विसर्ग** of नमस् and पुरस्, when they are **गति**, becomes स् before a hard guttural or labial.
8.3.41: A **विसर्ग** preceded by इ or उ and not part of an affix becomes ष् before a hard guttural or labial (in निर्, दुर्, बहिर्, आविस्, चतुर्, प्रादुस्).
8.3.42: The **विसर्ग** of the **गति** तिरस् optionally becomes स् before a hard guttural or labial.
8.3.43: The **विसर्ग** of द्विस्, त्रिस्, चतुर् as numeral adverbs (in the sense of **कृत्वसुच्**) optionally becomes ष् before a hard guttural or labial.
8.3.44: The **विसर्ग** of words ending in इस् or उस् optionally becomes ष् before a hard guttural or labial when the two words stand in syntactic relation (**सामर्थ्य**).
8.3.45: In a compound, the **विसर्ग** of an इस्- or उस्-ending word that no other word precedes always becomes ष् before a hard guttural or labial.
8.3.46: In a compound, the **विसर्ग** after अ of a non-indeclinable that no other word precedes becomes स् before कृ, कम्, कंस, कुम्भ, पात्र, कुशा, or कर्णी.
8.3.47: In a compound, the **विसर्ग** of अधस् or शिरस् that no other word precedes becomes स् before पद।
8.3.48: In कस्क and the rest, the **विसर्ग** becomes स् or ष् before a hard guttural or labial — ष् after इ or उ, स् elsewhere.
8.3.49: In the **छन्दस्**, the **विसर्ग** optionally becomes स् before a hard guttural or labial — but not before प्र, nor before a doubled (**आम्रेडित**) word.
8.3.50: In the **छन्दस्**, the **विसर्ग** becomes स् before कः, करत्, करति, कृधि, कृतः — but not the **विसर्ग** of अदिति।
8.3.51: In the **छन्दस्**, the **विसर्ग** of an ablative becomes स् before परि meaning 'over'.
8.3.52: In the **छन्दस्**, the **विसर्ग** of an ablative variously becomes स् before the verb पातु।
8.3.53: In the **छन्दस्**, the **विसर्ग** of a genitive becomes स् before पति, पुत्र, पृष्ठ, पार, पद, पयस्, or पोष।
8.3.54: In the **छन्दस्**, the genitive **विसर्ग** of इडा optionally becomes स् before पति, पुत्र, पृष्ठ, पार, पद, पयस्, or पोष।
8.3.55: From here on, supply: a cerebral sound replaces (the following), and only when that sound does not stand at the end of a **पद**।
8.3.56: The स् of सह्, in its form साड् (साट्), becomes ष्।
8.3.57: From here to the end of the chapter, supply: when an **इण्** sound (any vowel but अ/आ, or र्) or a guttural precedes.
8.3.58: The ष् replacement holds even when the augment नुम् (न्), a **विसर्जनीय**, or a sibilant (**शर्**) stands between the **इण्**/guttural and the स्।
8.3.59: After an **इण्** sound or a guttural, a स् that is an **आदेश** (from धात्वादेः षः सः) or part of an affix becomes ष्।
8.3.60: After an **इण्** sound or a guttural, the स् of शास्, वस् 'dwell', and घस् becomes ष्।
8.3.61: In the **षन्**-form Desiderative (where सन् has its ष्), the स् of स्तु and of the **णिच्** roots that begin with ष् in the **धातुपाठ** — and only these — becomes ष् after the reduplicate.
8.3.62: After the reduplicate of the **षन्** Desiderative, the स् of the **णिच्** roots स्विद्, स्वद्, and सह् stays स् (blocking the cerebral).
8.3.63: For the roots up to (but not) सित् in 8.3.70, the coming ष् replacement of स् holds even when the augment अट् stands between.
8.3.64: For स्था and the rest up to (but not) सित्, the ष् replacement holds even when the reduplicate stands between, and the स् of that reduplicate also becomes ष्।
8.3.65: After the इ or उ of an **उपसर्ग**, the स् of सुनोति, सुवति, स्यति, स्तौति, स्तोभति, स्था, सेनय, सेध, सिच्, सञ्ज्, स्वञ्ज् becomes ष्।
8.3.66: The स् of **सद्** becomes ष after an **उपसर्ग** holding इ or उ, except after प्रति.
8.3.67: The स् of **स्तम्भ्** becomes ष after an **उपसर्ग** holding इ or उ (and here प्रति is not excluded).
8.3.68: The स् of **स्तम्भ्** becomes ष after the **उपसर्ग** अव when the sense is support or nearness.
8.3.69: The स् of **स्वन्** becomes ष after वि and अव when the sense is smacking while eating.
8.3.70: After परि, नि, वि the स् of सेव्, सित, सय, सिव्, सह, the augment सुट्, स्तु, and स्वञ्ज् becomes ष.
8.3.71: For the सिव्-group (सिव्, सह, सुट्, स्तु, स्वञ्ज्) after परि, नि, वि, the ष change is optional even when the augment अ stands between **उपसर्ग** and root.
8.3.72: After अनु, वि, परि, अभि, नि the स् of स्यन्द् optionally becomes ष when the subject is not a living being.
8.3.73: After वि the स् of स्कन्द् optionally becomes ष, but not in the **निष्ठा** participles (त, तवत्).
8.3.74: After परि the स् of स्कन्द् optionally becomes ष everywhere, **निष्ठा** included.
8.3.75: In the usage of the Eastern Bharatas परिस्कन्द keeps its स्, with no ष change.
8.3.76: After निस्, नि, वि the स् of स्फुर् and स्फुल् optionally becomes ष.
8.3.77: After वि the स् of स्कम्भ् always becomes ष.
8.3.78: After an **अङ्ग** ending in an **इण्** vowel, the ध् of षीध्वम् and of the **लुङ्** and **लिट्** endings becomes the cerebral ढ्.
8.3.79: After the augment इट् (itself following an **इण्**-final **अङ्ग**), the ध् of षीध्वम् and of the **लुङ्** and **लिट्** endings optionally becomes cerebral ढ्.
8.3.80: In a compound the स् of सङ्ग becomes ष after अङ्गुलि.
8.3.81: In a compound the स् of स्थान becomes ष after भीरु.
8.3.82: In a compound the स् of स्तुत्, स्तोम, and सोम becomes ष after अग्नि.
8.3.83: In a compound the स् of स्तोम becomes ष after ज्योतिस् and आयुस्.
8.3.84: In a compound the स् of स्वसृ optionally becomes ष after मातृ and पितृ.
8.3.85: In a compound the स् of स्वसृ optionally becomes ष after मातुर् and पितुर्.
8.3.86: After the doubled **उपसर्ग** अभिनिस् the स् of स्तन् optionally becomes ष when the word names a sound (the **विसर्ग**).
8.3.87: The स् of अस् becomes ष when an इ- or उ-bearing **उपसर्ग** or प्रादुस् precedes and a vowel or य् follows.
8.3.88: After सु, वि, निर्, दुर् the स् of सुप् (vocalized स्वप्), सूति, and सम becomes ष.
8.3.89: After नि and नदी the स् of स्ना becomes ष when the sense is skilled.
8.3.90: प्रतिष्णात, with the ष, is the fixed form when it means सूत्र (pure).
8.3.91: कपिष्ठल, with the ष, is the fixed form when it names the founder of that **गोत्र**.
8.3.92: प्रष्ठ, with the ष, is the fixed form when it means a leader, one going in front.
8.3.93: विष्टर, with the ष, is the fixed form in the sense of tree and seat.
8.3.94: विष्टार, with the ष, is also the fixed form when it names a meter.
8.3.95: The स् of स्थिर becomes ष after गवि and युधि.
8.3.96: The स् of स्थल becomes **ष्** after वि, कु, शमि, परि: विष्ठलम्, कुष्ठलम्, शमिष्ठलम्, परिष्ठलम्. The शमि shows short इ; with long ई (शमीस्थलम्) the change drops.
8.3.97: The स् of स्थ becomes **ष्** after अम्ब, आम्ब, गो, भूमि, सव्य, अप, द्वि, त्रि, कु, शेकु, शङ्कु, अङ्गु, मञ्जि, पुञ्जि, परमे, बर्हिस्, दिवि, अग्नि: गोष्ठः, भूमिष्ठः, अङ्गुष्ठः, परमेष्ठः, बर्हिष्ठः and so on. (स्थ here is the bare word-form, not the genitive of स्था.)
8.3.98: The स् becomes **ष्** in सुषामन्, निष्षाम, सुष्ठु, गौरिषक्थ, प्रतिष्णिका and the rest of the सुषामादि list — an open class catching cerebral **ष्** changes no specific rule supplies.
8.3.99: A स् after an **इण्** or **कु** letter, before ए, becomes **ष्** when the word is a name and the स् is not preceded by ग्: हरिषेणः, वारिषेणः, जानुषेणी. (Not पृथुसेनः, a non-name; not विष्वक्सेनः, where ग् precedes.)
8.3.100: After a नक्षत्र name the स् optionally becomes **ष्** under the same conditions: रोहिणीषेणः or रोहिणीसेनः. Still not after ग् (शतभिषक्सेनः).
8.3.101: A final स् after a short vowel becomes **ष्** before a **तद्धित** beginning with त (तर, तम, तय, त्व, तल्, तस्, त्यप्): सर्पिष्टरम्, यजुष्टमम्, सर्पिष्टा. Not after a long vowel (गीस्तरा), not before non-त (सर्पिस्साद्भवति), not outside **तद्धित** (सर्पिस्तरति).
8.3.102: The स् of निस् becomes **ष्** before तप् when the sense is not repeated heating: निष्टपति सुवर्णम् (heats it once). When the sense is doing it again and again, it stays स् (निस्तपति).
8.3.103: Within a single पाद (line) of a verse, a स् becomes **ष्** before the त of युष्मद् (त्वम्, त्वाम्, ते, तव), तत्, and ततक्षुस्: अग्निष्ट्वम्, अग्निष्टे, अग्निष्टत्, निष्टतक्षुः. Not when the त starts the next पाद.
8.3.104: Some teachers extend that change to the यजुर्वेद too, so before युष्मद्, तत्, ततक्षुस् you get either form: अर्चिर्भिष्ट्वम् or अर्चिर्भिस्त्वम्, अग्निष्टत् or अग्निस्तत्.
8.3.105: In the **छन्दस्**, some teachers change the स् of स्तुत and स्तोम to **ष्**: त्रिभिष्टुतस्य or त्रिभिस्तुतस्य, गोष्टोमम् or गोस्तोमम्.
8.3.106: In the **छन्दस्**, by some teachers a स् at the start of a later word becomes **ष्** when the **पूर्वपद** supplies an **इण्** or **कु** letter: द्विषन्धिः, मधुष्ठानम्, द्विषाहस्रम् — each also keeping the plain स् form.
8.3.107: In the **छन्दस्**, by some teachers the स् of the particle सु becomes **ष्** after a **पूर्वपद** carrying the change-causing letter: अभी षु णः, ऊ षु णः.
8.3.108: Under those same conditions, the स् of सन् (to win) becomes **ष्** when its न् has dropped: गोषाः, नृषाः. With the न् kept (गोसनिम्) it stays स्.
8.3.109: The स् of सह becomes **ष्** after पृतना and ऋत: पृतनाषाहम्, ऋताषाहम् (and, by the च, ऋतीषहम्).
8.3.110: The **ष्** change is blocked when र् follows the स्, and in सृप, सृज, स्पृश, स्पृह, and the सवनादि list: विस्रब्धः, विसृपः, विसर्जनात्, दिविस्पृशम्, निस्पृहम्, सवने सवने, गोसनिम्.
8.3.111: The **ष्** change is blocked in the affix सात् and for a स् that starts a word: अग्निसात्, दधिसात्, मधुसात्; दधि सिञ्चति, मधु सिञ्चति.
8.3.112: The स् of सिच् stays स् before the **यङ्** (intensive): सेसिच्यते, अभिसेसिच्यते. (Not in the desiderative: अभिषिषिक्षति.)
8.3.113: The स् of सेध् stays स् when the sense is moving (driving animals along): अभिसेधयति गाः. When the sense is holding back, it changes (प्रतिषेधयति).
8.3.114: प्रतिस्तब्ध and निस्तब्ध keep their स् against expectation; the **ष्** change does not reach them.
8.3.115: The स् of सह in its सोढ form stays स्: परिसोढः, परिसोढुम्, परिसोढव्यम्. (As सह proper it changes: परिषहते.)
8.3.116: In the reduplicated aorist (**चङ्**) the स् of स्तम्भ्, सिव्, सह stays स्: पर्यतस्तम्भत्, पर्यसीषिवत्, पर्यसीषहत्. (This blocks only the change the **उपसर्ग** would cause, not the one from the reduplicate.)
8.3.117: The स् of सु (सुनोति) stays स् before स्य and सन् — that is, in future, conditional, and desiderative: अभिसोष्यति, अभ्यसोष्यत्, अभिसुसूः. (Elsewhere it changes: सुषाव.)
8.3.118: In the **लिट्** (perfect), the later स् of सद् and ष्वञ्ज् — the one after the reduplicate — stays स्: अभिषसाद, निषसाद, परिषस्वजे (the first स् changes, the second does not).
8.3.119: In the Vedas, after the **उपसर्ग** नि, वि, or अभि, a स् becomes ष् only optionally when the augment अट् stands between.
8.4.1: न् becomes **ण्** after र् or ष् when both stand in the same word: आस्तीर्णम्, विस्तीर्णम्, कृष्णाति, मुष्णाति. Not across word boundaries (अग्निर्नयति). (ऋ counts as र् here: मातॄणाम्.)
8.4.2: न् still becomes **ण्** after र् or ष् even when an **अट्** letter (vowel or य् व् ह्), a guttural (**कु**), a labial (**पु**), the आङ्, or the augment **नुम्** stands between: करणम्, अर्केण, दर्पेण, पर्याणद्धम्, बृंहणम्.
8.4.3: न् becomes **ण्** when the र्/ष् sits in the **पूर्वपद** of a compound that is a name, provided that **पूर्वपद** does not end in ग्: द्रुणसः, खरणसः, शूर्पणखा. Not in a non-name (चर्मनासिकः); not after ग् (ऋगयनम्).
8.4.4: The न् of वन becomes **ण्** after पुरगा, मिश्रका, सिध्रका, शारिका, कोटरा, अग्रे in a name: पुरगावणम्, शारिकावणम्, अग्रेवणम्. After these words only — कुबेरवनम्, असिपत्रवनम् keep न्.
8.4.5: The न् of वन becomes **ण्** even when the compound is not a name, after प्र, निर्, अन्तर्, शर, इक्षु, प्लक्ष, आम्र, कार्ष्य, खदिर, पीयूक्षा: प्रवणे, शरवणम्, इक्षुवणम्, आम्रवणम्.
8.4.6: The न् of वन optionally becomes **ण्** when the **पूर्वपद** names a perennial herb (**ओषधि**) or a tree (**वनस्पति**) and carries the change-causing letter: दूर्वावणम् or दूर्वावनम्, शिरीषवणम् or शिरीषवनम्.
8.4.7: In अहन्, न् becomes ण् when the प्रथमपद ends in अ and holds the trigger (र् or ष्): पूर्वाह्णः, अपराह्णः.
8.4.8: In वाहन, न् becomes ण् when the प्रथमपद names the thing carried and holds the trigger: इक्षुवाहणम्, शरवाहणम्.
8.4.9: In पान as the उत्तरपद, न् becomes ण् when the प्रथमपद holds the trigger and the whole compound names a country or its people: क्षीरपाणा उशीनराः.
8.4.10: In पान, न् optionally becomes ण् when the compound names the action (भाव) or the instrument (करण) and the प्रथमपद holds the trigger: क्षीरपाणम्/क्षीरपानम्, क्षीरपाणः/क्षीरपानः कंसः.
8.4.11: When the trigger stands in the प्रथमपद, न् optionally becomes ण् if it ends a प्रातिपदिक, is the augment **नुम्**, or sits in a **विभक्ति**: माषवापिणौ/माषवापिनौ, माषवापाणि/माषवापानि, माषवापेण/माषवापेन.
8.4.12: When the उत्तरपद is monosyllabic, that न् (ending a प्रातिपदिक, the augment **नुम्**, or in a **विभक्ति**) becomes ण् without option once the प्रथमपद holds the trigger: वृत्रहणौ, वृत्रहणः.
8.4.13: When the उत्तरपद contains a गुत्तुरल (क-वर्ग), that न् (ending a प्रातिपदिक, the augment **नुम्**, or in a **विभक्ति**) becomes ण् without option once the प्रथमपद holds the trigger: वस्त्रयुगिणौ, वस्त्रयुगाणि, वस्त्रयुगेण.
8.4.14: In a root listed with initial ण् in the धातुपाठ (a **णोपदेश**), न् becomes ण् when an **उपसर्ग** holds the trigger, even with no compound: प्रणमति, परिणमति, प्रणायकः.
8.4.15: In हिनु and मीना, न् becomes ण् when an **उपसर्ग** holds the trigger: प्रहिणोति, प्रमीणाति.
8.4.16: In आनि, the **लोट्** ending of the first person, न् becomes ण् when an **उपसर्ग** holds the trigger: प्रवपाणि, परिवपाणि.
8.4.17: In the prefix नि, न् becomes ण् when an **उपसर्ग** holds the trigger and one of these roots follows: गद, नद, पत, पद, the **घु** roots, मा, स्यति, हन्ति, याति, वाति, द्राति, प्साति, वपति, वहति, शाम्यति, चिनोति, देग्धि: प्रणिगदति, प्रणिहन्ति.
8.4.18: For the remaining roots, न् of नि optionally becomes ण् when an **उपसर्ग** holds the trigger, provided the root in its **उपदेश** form does not begin with क् or ख् and does not end in ष्: प्रणिपचति/प्रनिपचति.
8.4.19: In अन् 'breathe', न् becomes ण् when an **उपसर्ग** holds the trigger: प्राणिति, पराणिति.
8.4.20: In अन् 'breathe', न् becomes ण् when an **उपसर्ग** holds the trigger and the न् ends a **पद**: हे प्राण्, हे पराण्.
8.4.21: In the reduplicated forms of अन्, both न्-s become ण् when an **उपसर्ग** holds the trigger: प्राणिणिषति, प्राणिणत्.
8.4.22: In हन्, the न् preceded by short अ becomes ण् when an **उपसर्ग** holds the trigger: प्रहण्यते, प्रहणनम्.
8.4.23: In हन्, before व् or म्, the न् optionally becomes ण् when an **उपसर्ग** holds the trigger: प्रहण्वः/प्रहन्वः, प्रहण्मः/प्रहन्मः.
8.4.24: In हन्, the न् preceded by short अ becomes ण् after the **उपसर्ग** अन्तर् when the word does not name a country: अन्तर्हण्यते, अन्तर्हणनम्.
8.4.25: In अयन, न् becomes ण् after अन्तर् when the word does not name a country: अन्तरयणम्.
8.4.26: In the **छन्दस्**, न् of the उत्तरपद becomes ण् after a प्रथमपद ending in short ऋ, and stays ण् even at the अवग्रह (the pause of the पदपाठ): नृमणाः, पितृयाणम्.
8.4.27: In the **छन्दस्**, न् of the pronoun नस् becomes ण् after a root holding र् or ष्, or after उरु or षु: रक्षा णः, उरु णस्कृधि, अभी षु णः.
8.4.28: न् of नस् becomes ण् variously when an **उपसर्ग** holds the trigger: प्रणः, प्रणसः, प्रणो राजा.
8.4.29: न् of a **कृत्** affix, preceded by a vowel, becomes ण् when an **उपसर्ग** holds the trigger: प्रयाणम्, प्रमाणम्, प्रहीणः.
8.4.30: न् of a **कृत्** affix added after a causative (**णि**) stem optionally becomes ण् when an **उपसर्ग** holds the trigger: प्रयापणम्/प्रयापनम्.
8.4.31: न् of a **कृत्** affix (preceded by a vowel) added after a root that begins with a consonant and has an **इच्** vowel (इ, उ, ऋ, ऌ, ए, ओ, ऐ, औ) as its penult optionally becomes ण् when an **उपसर्ग** holds the trigger: प्रकोपणम्/प्रकोपनम्.
8.4.32: न् of a **कृत्** affix added after a consonant-ending root that begins with an **इच्** vowel and carries the augment **नुम्** becomes ण् when an **उपसर्ग** holds the trigger: प्रेङ्खणम्, प्रोम्भणम्.
8.4.33: न् of निंस, निक्ष, and निन्द optionally becomes ण् when an **उपसर्ग** holds the trigger: प्रणिंसनम्/प्रनिंसनम्, प्रणिन्दनम्/प्रनिन्दनम्.
8.4.34: न् of a **कृत्** affix does not become ण्, even with an **उपसर्ग** holding the trigger, after भा, भू, पू, कमि, गमि, प्यायि, वेप्: प्रभानम्, प्रभवनम्, प्रकमनम्.
8.4.35: After a ष् ending a **पद**, न् does not become ण्: निष्पानम्, दुष्पानम्.
8.4.36: In नश् 'perish', the न् does not become ण् when the root ends in ष्: प्रनष्टः, परिनष्टः.
8.4.37: A **न्** at the end of a **पद** does not become **ण्**.
8.4.38: **न्** does not become **ण्** when a **पद** stands between the trigger and the **न्**.
8.4.39: In क्षुभ्ना and the words of its **गण**, **न्** does not become **ण्**.
8.4.40: स् and the **तवर्ग** (dentals) in contact with श् or the **चवर्ग** (palatals) change to श् and the **चवर्ग**: स्→श्, the dentals→palatals.
8.4.41: स् and the **तवर्ग** (dentals) in contact with ष् or the **टवर्ग** (cerebrals) change to ष् and the **टवर्ग**: स्→ष्, the dentals→cerebrals.
8.4.42: After a **टवर्ग** letter ending a **पद**, the dentals do not change to cerebrals, except before नाम्।
8.4.43: The **तवर्ग** (dentals) do not change to cerebrals before ष्।
8.4.44: After श्, the **तवर्ग** (dentals) do not change to palatals.
8.4.45: A **यर्** letter (any consonant) ending a **पद** optionally becomes nasal before a nasal.
8.4.46: A **यर्** letter (any consonant except ह्) standing after र् or ह् that follows a vowel is doubled.
8.4.47: A **यर्** letter following a vowel is doubled when no vowel follows it.
8.4.48: In reviling, the letters of पुत्र are not doubled before आदिनी।
8.4.49: A **शर्** (sibilant) is not doubled before a vowel.
8.4.50: By शाकटायन's option, a cluster of three or more consonants is not doubled.
8.4.51: By शाकल्य's view, there is no doubling anywhere.
8.4.52: By the view of all the teachers, there is no doubling after a long vowel.
8.4.53: A **झल्** letter becomes the matching **जश्** letter (voiced unaspirated) before a **झश्** letter.
8.4.54: A **झल्** letter in an **अभ्यास** (reduplicated syllable) becomes the matching **चर्** letter, and also the matching **जश्** letter — that is, it loses aspiration: a voiced one becomes **जश्**, a voiceless one becomes **चर्**.
8.4.55: A **झल्** letter becomes the matching **चर्** letter (voiceless unaspirated) before a **खर्** letter.
8.4.56: A **झल्** letter at a pause optionally becomes the matching **चर्** letter.
8.4.57: An **अण्** vowel (अ, इ, उ) at a pause, when not **प्रगृह्य**, optionally becomes nasal.
8.4.58: An **अनुस्वार** becomes the nasal homogeneous with a following **यय्** letter.
8.4.59: An **अनुस्वार** ending a **पद** optionally becomes the nasal homogeneous with the following letter.
8.4.60: A **तवर्ग** letter (dental) becomes the nasal-or-plain ल homogeneous with a following ल।
8.4.61: After उद्, the स् of स्था and स्तम्भ् becomes the dental homogeneous with the preceding त् (so स्→त्थ, later त्थ)।
8.4.62: After a **झय्** letter (voiced mute), ह् optionally becomes the voiced aspirate homogeneous with that preceding mute.
8.4.63: After a voiceless **झय्** mute, श् optionally becomes छ् before an **अट्** letter (vowel, or य्, व्, र्)।
8.4.64: After a consonant, a **यम्** letter (semivowel or nasal) is optionally dropped before the same **यम्** letter.
8.4.65: After a consonant, a **झर्** letter (mute or sibilant) is optionally dropped before a homogeneous **झर्** letter.
8.4.66: An **अनुदात्त** vowel becomes **स्वरित** after an **उदात्त** vowel.
8.4.67: गार्ग्य, काश्यप and गालव allow it, but for everyone else an **अनुदात्त** does not become **स्वरित** before a following **उदात्त** or **स्वरित** (here उदय means "following"). This blocks the previous rule.
8.4.68: The open (विवृत) अ that every operation of the grammar treated short अ as becomes the contracted (संवृत) अ it actually is in speech.
